items.name: New Zealand Nationals 2026
items.information:
New Zealand Nationals 2026 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition.
​
This competition is open to all competitors regardless of age, experience, or skill. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary.
​
Please make sure to read all the information in the FAQ and other tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.

[FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NewZealandNationals2026#65955-faq)
[Live Results](https://live.worldcubeassociation.org/)
[More upcoming NZ competitions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=NZ)
